analysis.evidence: The plural verb agrees with יְמֵי in כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל, “all the days of Mahalalel.” The numerical predicate gives the sum of his years, ninety-five plus eight hundred, for a lifespan of 895 years.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine plural, with prefixed וַ־ and no suffix
analysis.sense: to amount to a stated total

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל, “all the days of Mahalalel,” כָּל takes his days collectively. The verse gives their total as 895 years.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular noun in the construct state.

analysis.evidence: כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל means “all the days of Mahalalel.” The verse totals those days as 895 years and closes with וַיָּמֹת, “and he died,” identifying the span as his entire life.
analysis.morphology: Masculine plural construct noun with no prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: (pl.) days of a life, a reign or an age

analysis.evidence: In כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל (“all the days of Mahalalel”), the name identifies whose lifespan is counted. The verse totals his 895 years and closes with וַיָּמֹת (“and he died”), completing the genealogical notice for Kenan’s son.
analysis.morphology: Masculine singular personal name without prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: In חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה, חָמֵשׁ supplies the five in “ninety-five years.” The following eight hundred years bring Mahalalel’s lifespan to 895 years.

In חָמֵשׁ וְתִשְׁעִים שָׁנָה, the marked noun supplies the unit for ninety-five. The verse adds eight hundred years and calls the total כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל, “all the days of Mahalalel,” giving his lifespan.
שְׁמֹנֶה counts מֵאוֹת ‘hundreds’ in וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה ‘and eight hundred years’. The conjunction adds these years to the preceding ninety-five, giving Mahalalel a lifespan of 895 years.
analysis.morphology: Conjunction וּ־ prefixed to a feminine singular absolute cardinal numeral.
analysis.sense: eight as the multiplier of hundreds

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה, שְׁמֹנֶה counts the hundreds and שָׁנָה supplies the unit, giving “and eight hundred years.” Together with the preceding ninety-five years, this gives Mahalalel’s lifespan as 895 years.
analysis.morphology: Cardinal numeral, plural absolute, with no prefix or suffix.
analysis.sense: hundreds (plural מֵאוֹת, with the digits: three hundred to nine hundred)

analysis.evidence: In וּשְׁמֹנֶה מֵאוֹת שָׁנָה (‘and eight hundred years’), the marked שָׁנָה supplies the unit for the eight hundred. כָּל יְמֵי מַהֲלַלְאֵל (‘all the days of Mahalalel’) identifies the full count of 895 years as his lifespan.
analysis.morphology: Common noun, feminine singular absolute, with no prefix or suffix.

analysis.evidence: After totaling Mahalalel’s lifespan at 895 years, the verse closes with וַיָּמֹת. The masculine singular verb refers to Mahalalel and records his death.
analysis.morphology: Qal wayyiqtol, third person masculine singular, with prefixed וַ and no suffix
analysis.sense: die, come to the end of life
